description.p: This is a Linux GTK application made for developers and tinkerers to easily flash the PineTime smartwatch using an ST-Link programmer. If you own a PineTime devkit and an ST-Link, the app can do the following for you:

ul.li: Get the latest community bootloader and InfiniTime release flash it with the click of a button
Flash any binary from a given web URL to the watch
Flash any binary stored on your device to the watch

description.p: Some fixes for the Flathub CI.
Pinetime Flasher has been fully rewritten! This was done to support the latest runtimes and libraries, and to clear the way for future improvements.
